g.text: J1.3--4: external dry contact. Closed = battery enabled; open/disconnected = OFF. USB remains independent.

g.desc: J1.3--4: external dry contact. Closed = battery enabled; open/disconnected = OFF. USB remains independent.

g.text: Power rail serves core/camera, not servo motor current. TP/FAULT readings require an independent voltage measurement.

g.desc: Power rail serves core/camera, not servo motor current. TP/FAULT readings require an independent voltage measurement.

g.text: Qualified source wiring, interruption ratings, hot-plug waveforms and fault coordination remain bench release gates.

g.desc: Qualified source wiring, interruption ratings, hot-plug waveforms and fault coordination remain bench release gates.

g.text: Input supply must be fused/current-limited externally. Board copper before U9 is not protected by its current limit.

g.desc: Input supply must be fused/current-limited externally. Board copper before U9 is not protected by its current limit.

g.text: Reverse battery: R80/R82 limit EN/OV input injection below10uA; C80 and D8 are nonpolar.

g.desc: Reverse battery: R80/R82 limit EN/OV input injection below10uA; C80 and D8 are nonpolar.

g.text: R80 precedes the contact and limits wire-fault current. This is a power-enable contact, not a physical main-current break.

g.desc: R80 precedes the contact and limits wire-fault current. This is a power-enable contact, not a physical main-current break.

g.text: U9: TPS259470L active current limiting then thermal latch; ITIMER/AUXOFF deliberately NC.

g.desc: U9: TPS259470L active current limiting then thermal latch; ITIMER/AUXOFF deliberately NC.
